candidates.cp_b_title_en: Private Sector Collaboration: Forms and Compliance

cp_a.reason: Provides foundational overview: definition, composition, purpose, revision of principles, and non-enforcement nature.

units.zh: 沃尔夫斯堡集团是由全球银行组成的协会，制定金融犯罪风险管理政策与指引
units.en: The Wolfsberg Group is an association of global banks that develop policies and guidance for managing financial crime risk.

units.zh: 沃尔夫斯堡集团发布指引协助成员管理风险，保护业务免受犯罪滥用
units.en: The Wolfsberg Group issues guidelines to assist members in managing their risks, helping them make sound decisions about clients to protect their operations from criminal abuse.

units.zh: 沃尔夫斯堡集团于2000年在瑞士沃尔夫斯堡城堡成立，与透明国际合作
units.en: The group first came together in 2000 at the Château Wolfsberg in Switzerland, as part of a collaborative effort with representatives of Transparency International.

units.zh: 沃尔夫斯堡集团成员来自美国、英国、瑞士等九国的资深金融犯罪合规人员
units.en: The group is made up of senior financial crime compliance personnel from member banks, representing the US, the UK, Switzerland, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, Spain, and Japan.

units.zh: 沃尔夫斯堡集团无执法权，其出版物为金融机构提供可调整的指引
units.en: Note that the group has no enforcement powers; therefore, its publications are designed to be adapted to its members’ needs and serve as guidance notes for financial institutions depending on their organizational risk, regulatory standards, and business profile.

units.zh: 沃尔夫斯堡集团定期修订原则，为高净值客户、政治敏感人物和离岸实体风险提供最佳实践
units.en: The Wolfsberg Group routinely revises these principles to outline best practices for financial institutions to detect and mitigate risks associated with high-net-worth clients, PEPs, and offshore entities.

cp_b.title_zh: 私营部门合作：形式与合规要求
cp_b.title_en: Private Sector Collaboration: Forms and Compliance
cp_b.reason: Human review accepted the P2A boundary after checking the section-level review topic.

units.zh: 私营部门实体应合作发现跨机构的模式
units.en: For this reason, it is important that private sector entities collaborate with each other to spot patterns that are only evident when looking across institutions.

units.zh: 组织可通过行业协会或专门的反洗钱实体进行合作
units.en: Organizations can collaborate via established industry bodies like trade associations, or through bespoke AML entities.

units.zh: 一些合作团体旨在制定指导文件
units.en: Some groups collaborate to produce guidance.

units.zh: 私营部门合作团体分享最佳实践、类型学和风险信息，并吸纳公共部门代表
units.en: Other groups collaborate to share industry best practices, such as best practices for suspicious activity reporting. Many of these groups include representatives from public sector bodies or collaborate closely with them. Such groups might also share typologies and information on risks.

units.zh: 信息共享是私营部门间合作的重要形式
units.en: Information sharing is an important form of private-to-private sector collaboration.

units.zh: 组织可联合开发了解你的客户公用平台，共享资源并提高了解你的客户准确性
units.en: Organizations may also come together to develop or share capabilities, such as KYC utilities. These joint platforms allow organizations to pool their resources and expertise and improve the accuracy of their KYC procedures.

units.zh: 合规官可以且应当进行非正式合作
units.en: Compliance officers can and should engage in informal collaboration.

units.zh: 与同业分享观点和经验有助于对标控制措施并采纳最佳实践
units.en: Sharing perspectives and experiences with peer organizations can help benchmark controls against those of comparable organizations and identify and adopt best practices.

units.zh: 讨论须遵守当地数据隐私法和机构对保密信息的保护要求
units.en: Any such discussion should be compliant with local data privacy laws and with the organization’s own requirements regarding the protection of confidential or commercially sensitive information.

units.zh: 洗钱者和恐怖分子通过跨机构分散活动来规避检测
units.en: Money launderers and terrorists actively seek to avoid detection by spreading their activities across multiple financial institutions to avoid triggering an alert in any one institution.

units.zh: 沃尔夫斯堡集团和联合洗钱指导小组是合作制定指南的实例
units.en: For example, the Wolfsberg Group develops frameworks and guidance for financial crime risk management. Another example is the Joint Money Laundering Steering Group, an umbrella body through which the UK financial sector produces government-approved guidance.

units.zh: 一些司法管辖区已立法允许此类信息共享
units.en: Some jurisdictions have introduced legislation that enables this type of sharing.

units.zh: 在这些司法管辖区，组织可共享客户、活动和交易数据
units.en: In these jurisdictions, organizations may share data on customers, activity, and transactions.

units.zh: 信息共享可提高可疑交易报告质量，防止被退出的客户在其他机构重新开户
units.en: This can be highly impactful, resulting in better quality SARs and preventing customers who have been exited by one organization for AML/CFT concerns from opening an account at another.

candidates.cp_a_title_en: Predicate Offenses Harmonization and EU AML Single Rulebook
candidates.cp_b_title_en: FATF Recommendations 17-19: Third-Party CDD and AML/CFT Programs

cp_a.title_zh: 上游犯罪统一与欧盟反洗钱单一规则手册
cp_a.title_en: Predicate Offenses Harmonization and EU AML Single Rulebook
cp_a.reason: Covers predicate offense differences, Directive 2018/1673, 2024 amendment, and Single Rulebook.

units.zh: 2018年前，成员国对洗钱上游犯罪的定义存在差异。
units.en: Until 2018, member states differed on the predicate offenses for money laundering.

units.zh: 欧盟通过2018/1673号指令（反洗钱刑法指令）统一洗钱犯罪定义和处罚最低标准。
units.en: This led the EU to pass Directive 2018/1673, or the “AML Criminal Law Directive,” which establishes minimum rules concerning the definition of criminal offenses and penalties for money laundering.

units.zh: 2024年，欧盟修订2018/1673号指令，将违反限制性措施定为刑事犯罪。
units.en: In 2024, the EU amended Directive 2018/1673 to ensure that violations of EU restrictive measures constitute a criminal offense.

units.zh: 欧盟推出反洗钱单一规则手册（含第六项反洗钱指令）。
units.en: The EU also introduced the EU AML Single Rulebook, also known as the EU AML package, which includes the 6AMLD.

units.zh: 该框架首次结合法规与指令，提高成员国间的协调性和有效性。
units.en: For the first time, this framework combined a regulation with a directive to increase its level of harmonization and effectiveness within member states.

cp_b.title_zh: FATF建议17-19：第三方客户尽职调查与反洗钱/反恐怖融资计划
cp_b.title_en: FATF Recommendations 17-19: Third-Party CDD and AML/CFT Programs
cp_b.reason: These units cover the allowance of third-party CDD reliance and the requirement to implement AML/CFT programs, share information, and apply EDD for high-risk jurisdictions.

units.zh: FATF建议17-19允许金融机构在满足条件时依赖第三方客户尽职调查
units.en: Recommendations 17 to 19 advise jurisdictions to allow financial institutions to rely on third-party CDD if it meets certain criteria.

units.zh: 金融机构应实施反洗钱/反恐怖融资计划并对高风险辖区强化尽职调查
units.en: Financial institutions should implement AML/CFT programs, facilitate the sharing of information for AML/CFT purposes, and apply enhanced due diligence to business relationships and transactions with persons and institutions from jurisdictions FATF identifies as higher risk.

candidates.cp_a_title_en: Concentration Accounts: Definition, Purpose, and Money Laundering Risk
candidates.cp_b_title_en: Regulated and Obliged Entities: Definitions and Obligations

cp_a.title_zh: 集中账户：定义、用途和洗钱风险
cp_a.title_en: Concentration Accounts: Definition, Purpose, and Money Laundering Risk
cp_a.reason: Human review accepted this non-contiguous grouping because it forms one useful review topic in the section.

units.zh: 集中账户的定义：金融机构用于归集资金的中央账户，也称结算、归集、暂记或收款账户
units.en: A concentration account is a type of account used by financial institutions to aggregate funds from various sources into a central account. It is often referred to as a settlement, sweep, suspense, or collection account.

units.zh: 集中账户因交易量大、资金混合，易被洗钱分子利用以掩盖资金来源和去向
units.en: While concentration accounts serve legitimate purposes, they are also vulnerable to misuse by money launderers and other criminals. The main risk arises from the high volume of transactions and the pooling of funds, which can obscure the origins and destinations of money. This makes it easier for illicit funds to be mixed with legitimate funds, facilitating money laundering activities.

units.zh: 集中账户通过资金归集优化现金流、减少交易、简化对账
units.en: This centralization streamlines the management of funds, enabling institutions to optimize cash flow, reduce the number of transactions, and simplify account reconciliations.

cp_b.title_zh: 受监管实体与义务实体的定义和义务
cp_b.title_en: Regulated and Obliged Entities: Definitions and Obligations
cp_b.reason: This core point covers the classification of entities into regulated and obliged, their definitions, specific obligations (rules), examples (case), and overlap (fact), forming a coherent review topic on institutional accountability under financial crime regulations.

units.zh: 受监管实体是直接受金融监管机构监督的企业，如银行、货币服务企业等。
units.en: A regulated entity is a business that falls under the direct supervision of financial regulators, such as banks, money services businesses, and other financial institutions.

units.zh: 义务实体是更广泛的类别，包括受监管实体和受其他金融犯罪法律约束的非金融组织。
units.en: An obliged entity is a broader category that includes both regulated entities and nonfinancial organizations subject to other financial crime laws, such as ABC and sanctions regulations.

units.zh: 金融犯罪破坏经济稳定并带来负面社会后果。
units.en: Financial crime undermines economic stability and has wider negative societal consequences if ignored.

units.zh: 通过立法和监管对机构施加义务是打击金融犯罪的方式之一。
units.en: Imposing strict obligations through legislation and regulation on institutions with the objective of preventing illicit funds entering and flowing through the financial system is one of the ways to fight financial crime.

units.zh: 受监管实体与义务实体因类型不同，监管适用方式差异很大。
units.en: Depending upon the entity type, how regulation is applied can differ greatly due to the distinct differences between regulated entities and obliged entities.

units.zh: 受监管实体必须遵守详细的反洗钱/反恐怖融资要求，包括实施反洗钱计划、客户尽职调查、实时交易监控和可疑活动报告。
units.en: These entities must comply with detailed AML/CFT requirements which include, but are not limited to, implementing comprehensive AML programs, conducting customer due diligence, real-time transaction monitoring, and promptly reporting suspicious activity.

units.zh: 非金融行业如能源、采矿、物流、制药和房地产等也须进行风险评估并采取控制措施。
units.en: For example, sectors like energy, mining, logistics, pharmaceuticals, and real estate might not be directly regulated by financial authorities, yet they must perform risk assessments and have adequate and effective controls to deter financial crime.

units.zh: 义务实体应采取合理措施预防非法活动，并在执法行动后实施补救措施。
units.en: These organizations are expected to take reasonable steps to prevent illicit activities and to implement remediation measures following enforcement actions, such as fines or leadership changes.

units.zh: 一个实体可以同时是受监管实体和义务实体，适用所有相关金融犯罪法律。
units.en: An entity can be both regulated and obliged, meaning all relevant financial crime laws and regulations will apply to the institution.

cp_a.reason: Lists EU-specific regulatory reports MiFID II and 6AMLD as examples of jurisdiction-specific reporting.

units.zh: MiFID II交易报告用于描述金融交易以监控市场诚信。
units.en: Markets in Financial Instruments Directive II (MiFID II) transaction reports: Describe financial transactions for market integrity monitoring.

units.en: 6AMLD Reports: Focus on uniform definitions of predicate offenses and extended liability across member states.

units.zh: 各司法管辖区监管报告示例的列表引导。

cp_b.title_zh: 可疑交易报告提交截止日期及司法管辖规则
cp_b.title_en: SAR Filing Deadlines and Jurisdictional Rules
cp_b.reason: Human review accepted the P2A boundary after checking the section-level review topic.

units.zh: 各司法管辖区对提交报告有报告规则和截止日期。
units.en: Jurisdictions have reporting rules and deadlines for submitting reports.

units.zh: 若初始检测未识别嫌疑人且需进一步调查，可额外延长30个日历日。
units.en: If the initial detection does not identify a suspect and further investigation is required, an additional 30 calendar days might be permitted.

units.zh: 高风险活动可能适用加速提交要求，需立即报告。
units.en: However, for high-risk activities, expedited filing requirements might apply, necessitating immediate reporting.

units.zh: 美国金融犯罪执法网络要求可疑活动报告在初始警报后30个日历日内提交。
units.en: For example, in the US, FinCEN requires SARs to be filed within 30 calendar days of the initial alert.

cp_a.title_zh: 可疑活动报告时限要求
cp_a.reason: Human review accepted the P2A boundary after checking the section-level review topic.

units.zh: SAR申报必须及时且有效。
units.en: SAR filing must be timely and effective.

units.zh: 一旦活动被认定为可疑，报告时限开始，必须在监管机构规定时限内提交SAR。
units.en: Once an activity is deemed suspicious, the reporting timeline begins, and a SAR must be filed within the timelines set by the regulator.

units.zh: 一旦怀疑或知悉洗钱等犯罪活动，应立即提交可疑活动报告（SAR）。
units.en: You should recommend a SAR as soon as you suspect, or know, that a person is engaged in money laundering, terrorist financing, or other criminal activity.

units.zh: SAR/STR申报规定因机构和司法管辖区而异，但存在共同要求。
units.en: The regulations for filing a suspicious activity report (SAR) or suspicious transaction report (STR) vary by institution and jurisdiction, but there are common regulations throughout that call for investigators to follow timelines and limit information access.

units.zh: 警报生成后即可开始调查。
units.en: As soon as the alert is generated, the investigation can start.

units.zh: 美国规定SAR须在发现可疑活动后30个日历日内提交，可延期30天。
units.en: In the US, a SAR must be filed within 30 calendar days of the detection of suspicious activity, with the possibility of a 30-calendar-day extension in cases where no suspect can be identified.

units.zh: 各司法管辖区对SAR提交时限要求不同，从“合理可行时”到具体天数不等。
units.en: However, each jurisdiction has its own reporting requirements, which vary from “when reasonably possible” to a specific number of days after suspicion has been established.

cp_b.title_zh: AI辅助可疑活动报告起草
cp_b.reason: Core review point describing the emerging use of generative AI to draft SAR narratives, its quality and efficiency benefits, and the typical human-in-the-loop control.

units.zh: 可疑活动报告（SAR）起草是AI辅助自动化的新兴领域。
units.en: Another emerging area for responsible AI-assisted automation is SAR drafting.

units.zh: 生成式AI可参考历史SAR模式辅助调查员撰写SAR叙述。
units.en: Generative AI technology can assist investigators in generating SAR narratives by referencing previous SARs with similar patterns.

units.zh: AI辅助SAR起草可提高报告质量、一致性并缩短处理时间。
units.en: This approach improves reporting quality and consistency and significantly reduces turnaround time.

units.zh: 多数组织保留人工审核环节，由人最终判断是否提交SAR。
units.en: Most organizations retain a human in the loop to review the SAR and exercise final judgement in submitting the report.

candidates.cp_a_title_en: Singapore's National AML Strategy and Risk-Based Approach
candidates.cp_b_title_en: Introduction: Money Laundering Risks in Nonbank Financial Institutions

cp_a.title_zh: 新加坡国家反洗钱战略与风险为本方法
cp_a.title_en: Singapore's National AML Strategy and Risk-Based Approach
cp_a.reason: Outlines Singapore's updated National AML Strategy emphasizing a three-pillar framework and its risk-based approach requirements for FIs and DNFBPs.

units.zh: 新加坡于2024年10月更新国家反洗钱战略，强调预防、检测和执法三大支柱框架。
units.en: Singapore's National AML Strategy was updated in October 2024 and outlines its approach to combat money laundering risks, emphasizing a three-pillar framework of prevention, detection, and enforcement.

units.zh: 新加坡要求金融机构和DNFBP实施风险为本的反洗钱/反恐怖融资合规措施，包括客户尽职调查、强化尽职调查、持续交易监控和可疑交易报告。
units.en: Singapore follows a risk-based approach to AML/CFT compliance. This approach requires financial institutions and DNFBPs to implement CDD, enhanced due diligence for high-risk clients, ongoing transaction monitoring, and suspicious transaction reporting.

cp_b.title_zh: 引言：非银行金融机构的洗钱风险
cp_b.title_en: Introduction: Money Laundering Risks in Nonbank Financial Institutions
cp_b.reason: This core point captures the introductory overview of money laundering risks in nonbank financial institutions, including the key risks and challenges highlighted.

units.zh: 本模块涵盖洗钱对非银行金融机构的重大风险。
units.en: This module covers the significant risks money laundering poses to nonbank financial institutions.

units.zh: 犯罪分子越来越多地瞄准非银行金融服务以掩饰非法资金来源。
units.en: These services are increasingly targeted by criminals seeking to disguise the origins of illicit funds.

units.zh: 非银行金融机构在识别和减轻洗钱风险方面面临独特的反洗钱挑战。
units.en: While banks are heavily regulated and monitored for AML purposes, nonbank financial institutions often face unique challenges in identifying and mitigating the risks associated with money laundering.

units.zh: 课程介绍：学习非银行金融机构类型及其打击洗钱的挑战。
units.en: In these lessons, you will learn about the different types of nonbank financial institutions and delve into the specific challenges that they face in combating money laundering.

units.zh: 预期学习成果：学员将能更好地应对组织内的洗钱挑战。
units.en: With this knowledge, you will be better equipped to address these challenges within your organization.

cp_b.title_zh: 内部可疑交易报告审查流程及洗钱报告官职责
cp_b.title_en: Internal SAR Review Process and MLRO Role
cp_b.reason: Groups the MLRO responsibility, review steps, and timeline rule into one review point covering the internal process for handling a SAR before filing.

units.zh: 洗钱报告官（MLRO）或指定官员负责监督金融犯罪防控（金融犯罪防控）合规计划并最终决定是否提交可疑交易报告（SAR）
units.en: The MLRO, nominated officer, or equivalent is usually the individual responsible for overseeing the organization's AFC compliance program and making the final decision on SAR filing.

units.zh: 反洗钱报告负责人审查可疑活动报告并提出问题以确保叙述完整有力。
units.en: The MLRO, or designated secondary reviewer, reads the SAR and might raise questions for the investigator. This ensures the SAR narrative is cohesive and sufficiently robust.

units.zh: 反洗钱报告负责人和调查团队应制定允许反馈和补充调查的内部时间表。
units.en: Therefore, MLROs and investigation teams should create internal investigation and review timelines that allow for feedback and additional research.

units.zh: 提交可疑活动报告前可能需要进一步调查以获取更多信息。
units.en: Before deciding to file a SAR, the organization might need to conduct further research to obtain additional information. This need becomes evident during the SAR review process.

units.zh: 风险限额将整体风险偏好分配到具体业务单元并设定风险类别和集中度
units.en: Risk limits allocate the organization’s overall risk appetite to appropriate business units with specific risk categories and concentrations for each.

units.en: Inherent risk is the level of financial crime risk in place before an organization applies any mitigation controls.

units.zh: 固有风险是大多数风险评估的起点。
units.en: Inherent risk is the starting point of most risk assessments.

units.zh: 确定固有风险后，组织需考虑风险发生的可能性和影响，通常使用矩阵识别最高风险。
units.en: Once an organization establishes inherent risk, it considers the likelihood and impact of that risk occurring, typically using a matrix to understand the highest risks.

cp_a.title_zh: 客户摩擦的来源与影响
cp_a.title_en: Sources and Effects of Customer Friction
cp_a.reason: Core review point covering the definition, causes, and consequences of friction in customer journeys.

units.zh: 客户旅程中的摩擦源于过度联系或交易处理延迟。
units.en: Friction can arise when organizations excessively contact customers for information or delay processing their transactions.

units.zh: 客户在机构内持有多种关系时，容易导致不必要的联系。
units.en: Unnecessary contact often occurs when a customer holds multiple relationships within an organization.

units.zh: 公司董事同时拥有个人零售账户并担任贷款担保人时，可能面临重复的了解你的客户请求。
units.en: For example, a company director who has personal retail accounts and acts as a guarantor for a loan may face redundant KYC requests from three different business units.

units.zh: 延迟通常源于交易处理或新产品/账户审批。
units.en: Delays often stem from transaction processing or approvals for new products or additional accounts.

units.zh: 延迟可能由操作积压或需要更新客户风险状况导致。
units.en: These delays may result from operational backlogs or the need to update a customer’s risk profile before proceeding.

units.zh: 过度联系或延迟会增加运营成本并导致客户流失。
units.en: Excessive outreach or frustrating delays increase operational costs and may lead to customer attrition.

cp_b.title_en: Techniques for Putting the Customer at Ease
cp_b.reason: Provides actionable rules for building customer comfort (discretion assurance, interpersonal skills, free speech, template use, alertness) supported by the background fact of customer wariness.

units.zh: 区分匿名与谨慎，向客户保证机构将谨慎处理数据并遵守数据法规。
units.en: There is a difference between anonymity and discretion. Discretion is good, and commonly sought by customers, so assure them that the organization will treat their data with care and in adherence with relevant data regulations.

units.zh: 良好的人际交往能力和对话式沟通更容易让客户放松，而非像审讯。
units.en: Having good interpersonal skills and engaging in a conversational manner is more likely to put the customer at ease, as opposed to making the meeting feel like an interrogation.

units.zh: 工作人员应允许客户自由发言。
units.en: The staff member should allow the customer to speak freely.

units.zh: 使用模板和脚本可确保以适当详细程度收集所有必要信息。
units.en: Using a template and script ensures that all required information is collected with an appropriate level of detail.

units.zh: 工作人员必须对客户可能需要跟进或澄清的回应保持警觉。
units.en: However, it is important for the staff member to remain alert to customer responses that might require follow-up or clarification.

units.zh: 客户常因担心个人信息被用于营销、转售或泄露而不愿提供。
units.en: Customers are often wary of giving out personal information because they believe it will be used for marketing, resold, or otherwise compromised.

cp_a.title_en: Sources and Effects of Customer Friction
cp_a.reason: Core review point covering the definition, causes, and consequences of friction in customer journeys.

units.zh: 客户旅程中的摩擦源于过度联系或交易处理延迟。
units.en: Friction can arise when organizations excessively contact customers for information or delay processing their transactions.

units.zh: 客户在机构内持有多种关系时，容易导致不必要的联系。
units.en: Unnecessary contact often occurs when a customer holds multiple relationships within an organization.

units.zh: 公司董事同时拥有个人零售账户并担任贷款担保人时，可能面临重复的了解你的客户请求。
units.en: For example, a company director who has personal retail accounts and acts as a guarantor for a loan may face redundant KYC requests from three different business units.

cp_b.reason: Customer segmentation is a key practice for tailoring monitoring, illustrated by an example of high-cash businesses.

units.zh: 金融机构按业务类型、交易行为、地理敞口和风险水平进行客户细分。
units.en: Financial institutions perform customer segmentation for effective monitoring, either before or after developing the scenarios. They categorize customers by business type, transaction behavior, geographic exposure, and risk level.

units.zh: 高现金业务如便利店常有频繁现金存款，而受薪专业人士现金收款则异常。
units.en: For example, high-cash businesses such as convenience stores or restaurants often have frequent cash deposits, while a salaried professional receiving cash payments might be unusual.
